programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Sweety is in love with Sanjay, the son of rich businessman Rajaram. However, she is heartbroken when she sees his true colours at a party where he is under the influence of alcohol.

programme.title: Salaami
programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer has a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. While attempting to gather evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But, they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Gaddaar
programme.desc: A wealthy businessman's son manipulates a loyal friend into his personal schemes, but unexpected love and rising tensions threaten to unravel their lives.

programme.title: Radha Ka Sangam
programme.desc: Radha and Govinda are in love with each other and get married. Post the wedding, their life goes awry when Govinda is arrested, leaving Radha to tackle problems all alone.

programme.title: Prem Shakti
programme.desc: Ganga and Gauri anger an evil tantric by saving Nagaraj. Enraged, the tantric turns Gauri into stone and kills Ganga. Nagaraj blesses Ganga with rebirth and helps unite him with his love.

programme.title: Jigar
programme.desc: Duryodhan, a wrestler, is Raju's friend, but due to a misunderstanding he rapes and kills Raju's sister. Raju later seeks Baba Thakur's help to train in fighting to avenge his sister's death.

programme.title: Ghayal
programme.desc: Balwant Rai, a corrupt businessman, frames Ajay for the murder of his brother. Later, with no support from those close to him, Ajay takes an unlikely route to seek revenge.

programme.title: Tada
programme.desc: Balraj, an honest man, joins hands with a gangster in order to avenge his father's death. However, his upstanding brother Ajay opposes him as a police inspector.

programme.title: Maseeha
programme.desc: Krishna, a victim of the local gangster Surajbhan's atrocities, joins forces with Shiva, whose parents were killed upon Surajbhan's orders, and resolves to bring him down.

programme.title: Saaz
programme.desc: Sisters, Mansi and Bansi, face a setback in their relationship when Mansi becomes a popular singer and gets Bansi married to an ill-suited man.

programme.title: Barsaat
programme.desc: Badal, a simple village boy, falls for his classmate Tina. However, Tina's father does not approve of their relationship and conspires to separate them.

programme.title: Sahibaan
programme.desc: After being rejected by Sahibaan, Vijay, a philanderer, learns about her love affair with Gopi, a labourer. Soon, a distressed Vijay decides to kill Gopi.

programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural
programme.desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.

programme.title: Kudrat Ka Kanoon
programme.desc: When the good doctor Vijay is falsely accused and imprisoned, his wife and daughter, desperately seeking justice, are terrorised and slandered by the harsh eyes of society.

programme.title: Khal Nayak
programme.desc: Inspector Ram succeeds in nabbing notorious criminal Ballu. When Ballu's escape taints Ram's name, his fiancée, Ganga, decides to trap Ballu. But, things get complicated when Ballu starts liking her.

programme.title: Prem Rog
programme.desc: After a series of tragedies shake Manorama's life, Devdhar, her childhood friend who falls for her, vows to make her happy. In the process, he faces the wrath of Manorama's conservative family.

programme.title: The Don
programme.desc: A mysterious person vigilantly protects Vijay and his mother from notorious goons. His reasons for protecting them remain an unresolved enigma.
